_doc: Department mini-missions (trims). Each is a short job an officer pitches underway; benefit and cost are multipliers on hunt-engine parameters (web/hunt_rt_engine.js P.*) or named effects. One active trim per department; a new trim replaces the old. Delegation check (rating x 1.5 + noise - difficulty) sets how well it lands. See docs/mini_missions.md.

jobs.label: Run her hot
jobs.pitch: I can open her up, darlin'. More push when you need it. She'll run warmer for it.
jobs.objection: Warmer is my problem, not yours.

jobs.label: Quiet the bearings
jobs.pitch: Re-seat the drive bearings and she'll whisper. Can't redline her after, though. Not safely.

jobs.label: Tune the breach spool
jobs.pitch: I can shave a quarter off the spool. She'll be louder while she winds, mind.
jobs.objection: Louder at the worst possible moment.

jobs.label: Plumb the reserve tanks into the sink
jobs.pitch: Twenty percent more sink, if I borrow the reserve tanks. Venting takes longer to clear it, obviously. Obviously to me.

jobs.label: Fast fins
jobs.pitch: I can make the fins dump faster. They'll glow a little longer after you pull them in. Physics. Not my fault.
jobs.objection: A longer glow is a longer look at us.

jobs.label: Cold analysts
jobs.pitch: Throttle the analyst stations and they'll run thirty percent cooler. Reads take longer. I'll be bored. You'll be cold.

jobs.label: Long ears
jobs.pitch: I can stretch passive range fifteen percent. Classification will take longer at the edge. That's the trade.
jobs.objection: Seeing them sooner is no use if you can't name them.

jobs.label: Snap classifier
jobs.pitch: Faster calls, Captain. More of them will be wrong. I don't like it. You might.
jobs.objection: (Quill objects to her own idea, which is very Quill.)

jobs.label: Narrow ping
jobs.pitch: A narrow ping. Half the heat, half the shout. Two read rounds instead of three.
jobs.objection: Half a ping's half an answer.

jobs.label: Drill the solution
jobs.pitch: Two hours of drill and we'll solve faster. The lead will be by the book, though. Book's not always right.

jobs.label: Lead from judgment
jobs.pitch: Let me hand-tune the lead tables. Better leads. Solutions go stale quicker, so you'll be refreshing more.
jobs.objection: Hand-tuned means nobody can check it.

jobs.label: Mix the salvo
jobs.pitch: Swap two warheads for an EMP and a flare. More tricks, less bite.

jobs.label: Quiet approaches
jobs.pitch: I'll plot every dog-leg arrival on a cold approach. We'll arrive quieter. We'll arrive later.

jobs.label: Short legs
jobs.pitch: Cut the corners. We'll save time. We'll also arrive with less warning of what's waiting.

jobs.label: Ration the galley
jobs.pitch: I can stretch the stores. We'll save money. Nobody will thank me. Nobody ever thanks the rationer.

jobs.label: Feast night
jobs.pitch: One good dinner. Everyone. Real food. It'll cost us. It'll be worth it.

jobs.label: Trade at the buoy
jobs.pitch: There's a fellow at the next buoy with a spare coupling. No paperwork. No questions.

pell_assists.label: Let Pell trim the classifier
pell_assists.pitch: I can make the classifier faster and not wrong. That's the whole pitch. Also it's me.

pell_assists.label: Let Pell take the lead tables
pell_assists.pitch: Better leads, and they won't go stale. Abara will hate it. I'd hate it too, in her place.

pell_assists.label: Let Pell run the sink
pell_assists.pitch: I'd keep the sink a little emptier, all the time. Dace would have less to do. He'd mind.
